curriculum.hero.title: Learning that begins with play.
curriculum.framework.title: Early Years Learning Framework (Australia)
curriculum.framework.body: Belonging, Being and Becoming guides everything we plan: five principles, eight practices and five learning outcomes, delivered through play and a Reggio-inspired atelier.
curriculum.principles.title: 5 Principles
curriculum.principles.body: Secure, respectful and reciprocal relationships · Partnerships · High expectations and equity · Respect for diversity · Ongoing learning and reflective practice
curriculum.practices.title: 8 Practices
curriculum.practices.body: Holistic approaches · Responsiveness to children · Learning through play · Intentional teaching · Learning environments · Cultural competence · Continuity of learning and transitions · Assessment for learning
curriculum.cycle.title: The learning cycle
curriculum.cycle.body: Observe · Analyse · Plan · Implement · Reflect. Educators document each cycle as visible learning for children and families.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.notice: Draft — requires Neverland review before public launch.
privacy.body:
We collect name, email, phone and message for enquiries. Tour and waitlist requests also collect a child's date of birth and preferred date.
Submissions are emailed to Neverland's central inbox; no separate website submission database is maintained. Email providers process submissions and acknowledgements. We use spam checks and rate limits.
Google Analytics loads only with your consent. Retention periods for enquiry, tour and waitlist emails are pending approval.
